text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—On that day, I found myself bidding 
farewell to a fellow trainer who was being 
transferred to a regional academy starting 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Having lunch and tea together with you was 
truly a blast. Starting tomorrow... take 
care of yourself.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, take care. I'll do my best too.
...Yeah, take care. I'll do my best too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting tomorrow, I'll be spending more 
time alone. Wanting to cheer her on, yet 
feeling lonely―― truth be told, I felt 
both.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I can't just linger in sentimentality 
forever. Deciding it was time to switch 
gears, I headed to the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A breeze so light it normally wouldn't 
bother me. The fact that it does... is 
that a sign of weakness――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――――……Softly)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a gentle fragrance drifted by. 
I turned around toward the source of the 
scent.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —It's rather chilly today, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Until the wind dies down... Would you mind 
if I stayed here too?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: . ............—Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: If you'd like, please take this.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's a marigold sachet. I happened to 
finish making it just moments ago.
choice_data_list: Is it really okay for me to take this?
Are you sure I can have this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could it be―― that they were actually 
looking out for me?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. If it is to your liking.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Once, when I was feeling anxious on a 
trip... this fragrance saved me.
choice_data_list: I see. In that case... thank you kindly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The marigold sachet I received carried 
that lovely scent from earlier. ...A 
gentle, enveloping fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart gradually relaxed…… Before long, 
my true feelings spilled out before I 
could stop them.
choice_data_list:
Actually, looks like I'll have more alone 
time starting tomorrow.

Actually, it looks like I'll have more 
alone time starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Whatever... for what 
reason?
choice_data_list:
A peer of mine is being assigned to the 
regional circuit...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... That certainly leaves one 
feeling lonely, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Then I have a suggestion. Whenever you get 
lonely, won't you come visit here again?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'll come again too. If we're together…… 
I'm sure we can weather even the coldest 
winds.
choice_data_list:
...Thank you so much for your 
thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle warmth, softly embracing like a 
sunlit patch. Looking up at the skyâthe 
wind felt a little less cold than before.
choice_data_list: That took a weight off my chest.
Next time I come by, I'll bring some tea.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's wonderful to hear.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The day will surely come when you meet 
your friend again. Next time, it'll 
certainly be――with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: My...! That sounds wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll... go fetch some chai or 
something that complements the fragrance 
of the sachets.
